description: Coordinate specialist sub-agents over real background child runs: analyzer (read-only numbers), researcher (cited web research), coder (bounded patches in working clones), mailer (drafts that wait for approval), scout (qualified opportunities, never contacts anyone). Protocol: plan first, spawn 1-3 specialists per call with a concrete task each, do other work, then collect each child by conversationId and runId and merge only verified results; report still-running children with their ids instead of inventing outcomes. Spawn needs owner approval; every consequential child tool call needs its own approval. Nothing idles in memory: specialists load only when spawned.
